But the guilt-and-blast pattern is the live theme: she sent the identical "are you ignoring me on purpose" line to six cold fans in one 38 minute stretch, and on 7/24 chased Ivan after two clear nos, sliding a pitch from $2,000.00 down to $200.00.

Review Q2: wrap questions in play instead of stacking closed ones, "how old are you? you write like you've got something mature about you 😊".
Keep the classy-dirty register, blunt wording was the flag on Ivan.
